headlines.headline: KAWHI EXTENSION TALKS, GIANNIS-HEAT FIT DOMINATE PRESEASON BUZZ
headlines.detail: The Raptors are exploring a two-year extension to keep Kawhi Leonard, while Pat Riley welcomed Giannis Antetokounmpo to Miami and LeBron James chose the 76ers over reunions with the Heat or Cavaliers. NBA media days begin September 28 with training camps opening September 29.

headlines.headline: WINSTON TAKES OVER GIANTS AS HERBERT'S CHARGERS SPIRAL AT 0-2
headlines.detail: Jameis Winston returns to New York's starting job after Jaxson Dart's injury forced him into emergency action Monday night. Justin Herbert's winless Chargers face mounting scrutiny after an 0-2 start.

headlines.headline: NO. 1 TEXAS AT NO. 14 TENNESSEE HEADLINES LOADED WEEK 4 SATURDAY
headlines.detail: Saturday's slate features No. 1 Texas at No. 14 Tennessee, No. 2 Georgia, No. 4 Ole Miss at No. 21 Florida, and No. 17 Iowa at No. 18 Michigan, plus Colorado at Baylor.

headlines.headline: ARIZONA HEADLINES MIDNIGHT MADNESS AS ELIGIBILITY FIGHTS LINGER
headlines.detail: Arizona, coming off a Final Four run, holds Midnight Madness Saturday at McKale Center. Texas A&M has injunction hearings over transfers Jordan Pope and Rylan Griffen, and Washington signed Nevada transfer guard Tayshawn Comer.
